original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-compare-with-derived-completion}
Let $U$ be the punctured spectrum of a Noetherian local ring $A$.
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a coherent $\mathcal{O}_U$-module.
Let $I \subset A$ be an ideal. Then
$$
H^i(R\Gamma(U, \mathcal{F})^\wedge) =
\lim H^i(U, \mathcal{F}/I^n\mathcal{F})
$$
for all $i$ where $R\Gamma(U, \mathcal{F})^\wedge$ denotes
the derived $I$-adic completion.
stage_b_review_note: Compared directly with pinned Stacks algebraization.tex, proof-safe statement lines 3518–3529. The prepared assertion exactly reproduces the source lemma: U is the punctured spectrum of a Noetherian local A, F is coherent on U, I is arbitrary, and for every i the i-th cohomology of derived I-adic completion of the entire complex RΓ(U,F) is identified with the inverse limit of cohomologies of F/I^n F. No higher completeness, dualizing, or positive-degree restriction is introduced; hypothesis and conclusion split preserves quantification.
